eventName: The grand event of planting ten thousand palm seeds
eventDescription:
More than 400 participants, including students from Triveni Academy, Agathiyar Matriculation School, Masilamani Mudaliyar Higher Secondary School, Arignar Anna Government Boys Higher Secondary School, Palaveri Government School, volunteers, and the public from various places, took part in this initiative.
For several students, it was their first-ever experience planting a palm seed, making the event even more special.
This event stands as an important step in the effort to protect nature.
When such initiatives grow into people?s movements and green revolutions, our natural resources will flourish and remain protected.
